highlight: Tushant is an effective leader and passionate about what he does, working with him is always something I look forward to.
quote: I hope you are doing good, I wanted to share my experience working with EMB and Tushant. I'm delighted to have worked with Tushant for 2 weeks on the wallpaper app. Tushant is an effective leader and passionate about what he does. Although I worked with Tushant in a project manager's role, Tushant had many secondary roles which he carried out with apparent ease, possibly owing to his excellent communication skills. Add into the mix a sense of fun, working with Tushant is always something I look forward to. Tushant is an awesome person to work with and Expand My Business is lucky to have Tushant. We wish we can hire him someday.
name: Deepak Rajkumaran

highlight: You met our needs and then some, nothing but rave comments from the people closest to the product.
quote: I speak for the EMB, when I tell you how pleased we are with the application and web site you designed for us. Business needed a site that addressed varied aspects of our operation. You have met those needs and then some! We have had nothing but rave comments about the site from those who are closest to it and rely on it the most. I personally want to thank Tushant for the patience and diligence in promptly meeting each of our requests for the site during its development.
name: Sanatan Mishra
